content: Jesu ning Ratha kathamak kulutpa amindam
Jesu le ama thiemroi ngai Galilee tuitham ralkhat teng, Gerasa ramkol teng anwatung je.
Jesu rukuong ria kinrangtak a ahei suoklimli, thaan khur ria ahei kosuok pasal inkhat ning ama alei kintong pui. Hiwa mipa hi asunga ratha kathamak aleikoron a e,
khan thaanna alei kaom e. Tute ningnum thirrui khit a anda tormak je alei e;
ake le akut thirrui a anlei khitchak, tak apha rikip a thirrui kha aphoi chet a thir khaning ake alei rachak. Ama ranak aleirat rangra khana tu tening num leikhap tormuk.
Sun le jan thaan le chingmoul kutung alonna, aleikheek a khan abinga lungning aleikin-at.
Amaning akalakdet a-om lai Jesu kha aleimu; khanchu alei taanna, amai kunga kemorkhup athep a aleikinkun,
khana aleikheek a, <<Jesu, Akin Sangtak Pathien Sapa! Kei angmo nulo rong niti e? Pathien jarra, kinini e, kei nimin pong moro!>> ati.
Amaning hi ati ajarchu Jesu ning aleiti, <<Ratha kathamak, hiwa mipa ria heisuokro!>>
Khawa jarra Jesu ning amadeng aleirakal, <<Niriming angmi?>> Mipa ning aleimasang, <<Kei kiriming, <Akatam> ajarchu keini kintam!>>
Khan khawa ram ria ratha kathamak ngaikha aholsuok mak nasik amaning Jesu deng akin ni a aleiom.
Khawa kolla khan wok katamtak rup inkhat khawa chingkolla khan bu anbak a anleiom.
Khawa jarra ratha kathamak ngai khan Jesu deng anleini, <<Wok ngai deng son numoso ro, asunga lutkinte,>>
Amaning aminse jei, ratha kathamak ngai kha mipa deng ria ansuok a wok ngai sunga anhong lut je. Wok ngaikha akin chuna lising inni kopo an e, korolkham ankin chom thak a tuitham sunga anlut rip jei.
Wok kakhal ngai kha antaan a khopui sunga le akho khoa anwaril minthang jei. Mipui ngaikha omchen akosuok aka-en sik anheiwa.
Khana anmani ning Jesu deng anhong karra, akatam khori koronpa kha anleimu. Ama khana khan alei kin ong, pon akinsilla akilim senga aleiom; khan anmani rikip ning anlei chi.
Khori kulutpa le wok ngai chunga kosuok omchen aleikumu ngaining mipui ngaideng anleiril pe.
Khawa jarra anmani ning Jesu deng anram moso nasik a anleiti.
Jesu ning rukuong sunga alutlai, khori koronpa khaning, <<Nangle sebung ri!>> tia aleikinni.
Takkha Jesu ning leinom pe mak. Khawa nek a amaning aleiti, <<Nang na-inna kir-inlang na-insung mi ngaideng angtuk a Puma ning nangsik a anathope le anaminreng kha waminjet ro.>>
Khawa jarra mipa kha Decapolis (tinachu Khopui som) kutungbit aleise, Jesu ning amasik angtuk a mo athope e ti kha awaril je. Khan akajet rikip ngaining anleingak.
Jairus sanu le Jesu aponmor kotoknu
Jesu tuitham ralkhat teng rukuong a akirnok. Khawa tuitham kolla khan mipui katamtak akolla ankintup je.
Jairus, khawa kho synagogue sik a sin koronpa, ahongtunga, khan Jesu amu a akekunga abinga ahongkinbok,
Khan mulung kuluttak a aleikinni, <<Kasanu kisin ranak tak a ana je. Minreng tak a hong inlang adam nasik le aring nasik achunga nukut nawada pero!>> aleiti.
Khan Jesu ama le kinroi a ase a, khan mi katamtak Jesu le kinroi a mipuining amakha anuk-ama ankin et-tarpui je.
Khawa khan kum somle inni thi akosuok khodeng kathei tak numeisa inkhat aleiom,
mika en thiempu katamtak ning anlei en rawang leidam mak. Asumsan nei rikip aleineiman so je, tak akana adampui nek a apha rikip a akintet det je.
Khawanu ning Jesu chungchanga aleijet, khawa jarra mipui karra ahonga anukteng ahei jui,
abinga alei kinti, <<Aponmor bei inum kokotok tor inchu damna kanei sik.>>
Khawanu ning aponmor alei kotok a, athi kosuok kha khawa phatak a abang je; khana akana kha adamjei tikha abinga mulung sunga akinjet.
Khawa laitak khan Jesu ning ama ria aranak akosuok kha aleijet je, khawa jarra amaning mipui ngaideng ahei kinhei a a-enna aleirakal, <<Atu ningmo kopon akotok e?>>
Ama thiemroi ngaining anheimasanga, <<Mipui hiseng hining ana-umtur numu; angsik a mo nangdeng anukotok kha nana rakal e?>>
Takkha Jesu ning khawa akotok mikha amu nasik asir-apang alei en.
Numeinu achunga omchen kosuok kha akin jet a, achi pumma ahonga, ake kunga akinkunna, akidik rikip kha amadeng awaril je.
Jesu ning khawanu deng aleiti, <<Kasanu, nataksenna khaning animindam eje. Akahoi-akadai a setro, napongna ria dam rang ro.>>
Jesu ning hi arillai, Jairus inn ria chongkoron mi alek anhonga amadeng anlei ti, <<Nasanu kha athijei, Oja kha angsik mo niminpong sik e?>>
Angmi anmanining anleitikha Jesu ning leirangai pemak,
takkha lamkakeipa deng aleiti, <<Chimaro, taksen bei taksen ro.>>
Khan amaning Peter, Jame khan anaipa John ilei a tute anuk leimin juimak.
Anmani ning Jairus inn anheitung je, khanna khan mingai kinhangna le chap ong rasa rikip Jesu ning aleijet.
Insung alut a anmanideng aleiti, <<Angsik mo ankin hang e? Angsik mo ninchap e? Naipangnu hi akithi imak, akajal e!>>
Anmani ning anlei munuipui, khawa jarra amaning anmani rikip tolla aleiminsuok, naipangnu anu le apa khan athiemroi inthum ngai aroi a naipangnu jalna den sunga anlut je.
Amaning naipangnu akut ama-o a aleiti, <<Talitha, Koum,>> hiwa tina chu, <<Naipangnu, keining thei ro kiti!>>
Khawa laitak khan naipangnu kha akinding a aleilon jel. Naipangnu kha kum somle-inni a ije. Khawa omchen asuoklai khan, anmani ning anleingak.
Takkha Jesu ning atukhat dengnum rilmaknasik tia anmanideng chong kharna aleinei, khan Jesu ning aleiti <<Naipangnu kha baksik angmikhat peru.>>
